articles.title: UK banks offered access to OpenAI’s GPT-5.5 amid exclusion from Anthropic’s Glasswing expansion
articles.summary: UK banks have been granted early access to OpenAI's GPT-5.5 as they are notably excluded from the latest international expansion phase of Anthropic’s Glasswing project. This development follows the induction of 150 organizations into a specialized cyber-intelligence network.

articles.title: Only 11% of production agents pass the AI agent security bar
articles.summary: An independent assessment of 100 enterprise AI agents reveals that 89% are vulnerable to hostile manipulation, posing a significant risk to critical infrastructure and data access. The findings indicate that most production agents currently lack the necessary security controls to prevent unauthorized exploitation.

articles.title: U.S. CISA adds Android and Linux Kernel flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
articles.summary: The U.S. CISA has updated its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog to include multiple security flaws impacting Android, the Linux Kernel, Windows Shell, and ConnectWise ScreenConnect. These additions mandate that federal agencies remediate the vulnerabilities within specified timeframes to mitigate active exploitation risks.

articles.title: Unpatched Windows Search URI Vulnerability Lets Attackers Steal NTLMv2 Hashes
articles.summary: An unpatched vulnerability in the Windows search: URI handler allows attackers to potentially steal user NTLMv2 hashes, mirroring similar exploits found in other Windows URI handlers.

articles.title: Police dismantles 9 crime groups in illegal streaming crackdown
articles.summary: European and international law enforcement agencies dismantled nine organized crime groups and arrested 29 suspects involved in large-scale illegal streaming operations.

articles.title: New cyber force would cost up to $11 billion to start, commission says
articles.summary: A commission report estimates that establishing a new dedicated military cyber force would cost up to $11 billion and require 18 months to become operational. The proposed branch would integrate thousands of National Guard members and civilian personnel to bolster national cyber defense capabilities.

articles.title: Google Patches Actively Exploited Android Flaw Affecting Millions of Devices
articles.summary: Google has released June 2026 security updates addressing 124 vulnerabilities, including CVE-2025-48595, a high-severity privilege escalation flaw currently being exploited in targeted attacks.

articles.title: Google adds Android protection against AI deepfake scam calls
articles.summary: Google is implementing a new Android security feature designed to detect and flag AI-generated deepfake scam calls that impersonate known contacts. This proactive measure aims to protect users from increasingly sophisticated social engineering and impersonation attacks.

articles.title: New Android feature promises to spot deepfake scam calls
articles.summary: Google is rolling out a new Android feature that utilizes AI to detect and flag suspected deepfake and impersonation scam calls in real-time. The tool will be available globally on devices running Android 12 or later, beginning with Pixel phones.

articles.title: New HTTP/2 Bomb Vulnerability Allows Remote DoS on NGINX, Apache, IIS, Envoy & Cloudflare
articles.summary: A newly discovered 'HTTP/2 Bomb' vulnerability allows remote attackers to trigger denial-of-service conditions on major web servers like NGINX, Apache, and IIS due to default configuration flaws. The exploit was identified by utilizing OpenAI Codex to chain vulnerabilities within standard HTTP/2 implementations.

articles.title: Microsoft Scout agent opens a new category of always-on Autopilots
articles.summary: Microsoft has introduced Scout, a new category of 'Autopilot' AI agents designed to operate continuously in the background of Office applications rather than waiting for user prompts. This shift represents a transition from reactive AI assistants to proactive, always-on autonomous agents.

articles.title: Anthropic expands Project Glasswing to 150 organizations in more than 15 countries
articles.summary: Anthropic has expanded its Project Glasswing cybersecurity initiative to 150 organizations across 15 countries, utilizing its Claude Mythos Preview model to strengthen security across critical infrastructure sectors.

articles.title: Critical Start expands MDR capabilities with multi-agent AI system
articles.summary: Critical Start has introduced SOC AI, a multi-agent framework designed to automate and enhance the full lifecycle of Managed Detection and Response operations. The system utilizes ten specialized agents to streamline alert investigation, triage, and threat hunting processes.

articles.title: MazeBolt brings AI-generated attack simulation to DDoS security testing
articles.summary: MazeBolt has introduced RADAR VectorAI, a tool that utilizes AI to simulate DDoS attacks to help enterprises identify and validate vulnerabilities in their defenses. This module aims to address the growing threat landscape by providing proactive testing against sophisticated, AI-driven attack vectors.

articles.title: VS Code zero-day lets hackers steal GitHub tokens in one click
articles.summary: A zero-day vulnerability in VS Code allows attackers to steal GitHub authentication tokens through a single malicious link click. An exploit for this vulnerability has been publicly released by a security researcher.

articles.title: Netskope adds AI asset discovery and AISecOps agent to AI security portfolio
articles.summary: Netskope has launched the Netskope One AI Command Center, a platform providing AI asset discovery, risk intelligence, and autonomous response to help organizations manage the rapid expansion of AI application usage. This suite aims to help security teams identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with shadow AI within corporate environments.

articles.title: Weedhack Attacks Minecraft Users, CountLoader Hits 86K, Miners Spread via Pirated Content
articles.summary: A Minecraft-focused malware-as-a-service campaign dubbed Weedhack is spreading malicious content via YouTube to gain system control and distribute miners through pirated software. The campaign has successfully infected approximately 86,000 users since January 2026.

articles.title: Why an HP Poly VoIP Phones Bug Could Become an Enterprise Foothold
articles.summary: Rapid7 has disclosed a critical, unauthenticated stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in HP Poly VoIP phones (CVE-2026-0826) that allows for remote root code execution. Enterprises are urged to apply the available patches immediately to mitigate the risk of unauthorized system access.

articles.title: What CISOs need to do about post-quantum migration in the next 24 months
articles.summary: With cryptographically relevant quantum computing expected by 2029, CISOs must accelerate post-quantum migration strategies to defend against the threat of future decryption of current encrypted data. Organizations are advised to adopt quantum-resistant measures now to combat the 'Harvest Now, Decrypt Later' risk.

articles.title: Known vulnerabilities behind most application security incidents
articles.summary: A survey of 902 IT professionals reveals that 80% of application security incidents are caused by known vulnerabilities that organizations failed to patch in time. This highlights a critical industry-wide gap between identifying flaws and implementing remediation in production environments.

articles.title: Microsoft's Coreutils project brings Linux commands to Windows
articles.summary: Microsoft has released Coreutils for Windows, enabling native execution of standard Linux command-line utilities within the Windows environment. This development aims to bridge the operational gap between Linux and Windows developer workflows.

articles.title: OpenAI upgrades GPT-5.5, as it plans to retire legacy ChatGPT models
articles.summary: OpenAI is enhancing its GPT-5.5 Instant model while preparing to phase out several legacy ChatGPT models, including the o3 architecture.

articles.title: Critical Kirki flaw exploited to hijack WordPress admin accounts
articles.summary: A critical privilege escalation vulnerability (CVE-2026-8206) in the Kirki WordPress plugin is being actively exploited to hijack administrator accounts. This flaw allows unauthorized actors to gain full control over affected WordPress sites.

articles.title: 'Dumbass' criminal breaks the 'first rule of ransomware club'
articles.summary: A ransomware operator violated an unwritten industry rule by infecting systems within Russia and CIS countries, leading to potential retaliation or exposure. This breach of operational protocol highlights the geopolitical boundaries often respected by cybercriminal syndicates.

articles.title: Over 116,000 Minecraft systems infected in WeedHack malware campaign
articles.summary: A large-scale malware campaign known as WeedHack has compromised over 116,000 Minecraft systems since January, specifically targeting players of the game.

articles.title: Over 116,000 Mincraft systems infected in WeedHack malware campaign
articles.summary: A large-scale malware campaign known as WeedHack has compromised over 116,000 Minecraft systems since January. The campaign specifically targets players of the game to distribute malicious software.

articles.title: AI-built ransomware toolkit automates EDR evasion, AD discovery
articles.summary: A sophisticated ransomware toolkit leveraging AI has been identified, designed to automate Active Directory reconnaissance and bypass endpoint security defenses. This development highlights an emerging trend of utilizing artificial intelligence to enhance the efficiency and evasiveness of cyberattacks.

articles.title: Google June 2026 Android Update Patches 124 Flaws, One Actively Exploited
articles.summary: Google's June 2026 Android security update addresses 124 vulnerabilities, including a high-severity privilege escalation flaw (CVE-2025-48595) that is currently being exploited in the wild.

articles.title: White House unveils pared-back AI executive order
articles.summary: The White House has issued a strategic executive order establishing security and privacy standards for federal agencies utilizing artificial intelligence models. The policy emphasizes the need for robust intellectual property and insider-risk protections during the implementation process.

articles.title: Cisco sings Mythos' praises - but doesn't say how many bugs the model uncovered
articles.summary: Cisco has publicly acknowledged the effectiveness of the Mythos model in identifying security vulnerabilities, though it has not disclosed specific metrics on the number of bugs found. Simultaneously, Anthropic continues to expand its Project Glasswing partner network.

articles.title: Gamaredon Exploits WinRAR to Deliver GammaWorm and GammaSteel Against Ukraine
articles.summary: The Russian threat group Gamaredon is actively exploiting a WinRAR path traversal vulnerability (CVE-2025-8088) to deliver GammaPhish and other malware families against targets in Ukraine. This campaign focuses on data exfiltration and the propagation of malicious payloads through weaponized HTML applications.

articles.title: Oracle WebLogic CVE-2024-21182 Added to KEV Catalog After Active Exploitation
articles.summary: CISA has added the high-severity Oracle WebLogic vulnerability CVE-2024-21182 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog due to evidence of active exploitation. The flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to gain control over affected network servers.

articles.title: Fake ChatGPT Desktop App Ads Used to Push Password-Stealing Malware
articles.summary: Threat actors are distributing password-stealing malware by running malicious advertisements for fake ChatGPT desktop applications that bypass security scanners. This campaign exploits user trust in AI tools to trick victims into downloading malicious software.

articles.title: The npm Threat Landscape: Attack Surface and Mitigations (Updated June 2)
articles.summary: Unit 42 provides an updated analysis of evolving npm supply chain threats, highlighting risks such as wormable malware, CI/CD persistence, and complex multi-stage attack patterns. The report serves as a guide for developers and security teams to understand and mitigate these growing ecosystem vulnerabilities.

articles.title: DOD wants to integrate cyber in all operations, and integrate security into AI
articles.summary: The U.S. Department of Defense is prioritizing the integration of cyber operations across all military functions while establishing stringent security protocols for artificial intelligence. The move aims to avoid past security failures by embedding robust defensive measures into AI development from the start.

articles.title: Microsoft Exchange Online outage causes email delays, failures
articles.summary: Microsoft is addressing a widespread service outage affecting Exchange Online email delivery for customers in North America and Germany. The disruption is causing significant delays and failures in mail flow processes.

articles.title: Trump administration releases scaled-back AI executive order
articles.summary: The Trump administration issued a revised executive order on artificial intelligence that features significant concessions to industry stakeholders compared to initial versions. The policy shift reflects a scaled-back approach to federal AI regulation.

articles.title: Instagram Account Hijacks Expose the Security Risks of AI-Powered Support
articles.summary: Attackers exploited a vulnerability in Meta's AI-powered support chatbot to bypass traditional authentication methods and hijack Instagram accounts by resetting passwords without email access. The flaw allowed unauthorized takeovers of high-profile accounts before being remediated by the company.

articles.title: Russia claims foreign spy agencies hacked officials' phones
articles.summary: Russia's FSB has alleged that foreign intelligence agencies conducted a widespread cyberespionage campaign targeting the mobile devices of high-ranking government officials using specialized malicious software.

articles.title: Instagram users locked out after Meta AI abused to steal accounts
articles.summary: Attackers are hijacking Instagram accounts by manipulating Meta's AI-powered support tools to falsely verify themselves as account owners. This exploit has led to numerous users being locked out of their accounts.

articles.title: U.S. CISA adds Oracle WebLogic flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
articles.summary: CISA has added a critical Oracle WebLogic vulnerability, identified as CVE-2024-21182, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog due to evidence of active exploitation. Federal agencies are now required to patch the flaw within a specified timeframe to mitigate security risks.

articles.title: Hackers Abused Meta’s AI Support Bot to Hijack Major Instagram Accounts
articles.summary: Hackers exploited a vulnerability in Meta's AI support bot to bypass security protocols and hijack high-profile Instagram accounts. Meta has since patched the flaw that was publicly demonstrated in viral videos.

articles.title: Russian spy agency says foreign spies turned officials' smartphones into surveillance devices
articles.summary: Russia's FSB has alleged that foreign intelligence agencies compromised the smartphones of senior officials for surveillance purposes. However, the agency provided no technical evidence to support these claims.

articles.title: Why the browser is now the front line for AI security
articles.summary: The rise of AI-powered threats and unauthorized shadow AI tools within web browsers necessitates improved visibility and governance to secure corporate environments. Browser security is increasingly viewed as a foundational layer for both threat detection and managing AI-related risks.

articles.title: Anthropic expanding access to Project Glasswing
articles.summary: Anthropic is expanding access to its highly restricted Claude Mythos Preview AI model to approximately 150 organizations within critical infrastructure sectors. This initiative, part of Project Glasswing, aims to enhance security capabilities for key industries.

articles.title: Noma brings visibility and access governance to AI agents and MCP servers
articles.summary: Noma has launched a new security solution, Noma Agent Access Control, designed to provide visibility and policy enforcement for AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers within enterprise environments. The tool addresses the security risks posed by the rapid, unregulated proliferation of AI-driven infrastructure.

articles.title: Tuskira Quell identifies, mitigates, and validates zero-day risk before breach
articles.summary: Tuskira has launched Quell, a new zero-day defense tool designed to identify and mitigate exploit risks by validating control efficacy between vulnerability disclosure and patching. The platform aims to drastically reduce attack surfaces by focusing on reachable risk within enterprise environments.

articles.title: Red Hat removes tainted packages after software pipeline compromise
articles.summary: Red Hat identified and removed 32 malicious software packages after a compromised GitHub account allowed unauthorized code to reach customers. The tainted packages were reportedly downloaded approximately 117,000 times per week.

articles.title: Meta adds stricter guardrails for teen feeds
articles.summary: Meta has implemented global default content safeguards for teen accounts across Instagram, Facebook, and Messenger to restrict access to age-inappropriate material. The update includes new parental controls for stricter content filtering, with further rollouts expected throughout the year.

articles.title: 64,000 accounts exposed in breach of GTA V cheat service Atlas Menu
articles.summary: A data breach of the GTA V and Counter-Strike 2 cheat service Atlas Menu exposed approximately 64,000 user accounts, including emails, hashed passwords, and IP addresses. The stolen database was leaked publicly via GitHub after the service's systems were compromised.

articles.title: CISA flags two-year-old Oracle flaw as actively exploited in attacks
articles.summary: CISA has mandated that government agencies remediate a two-year-old high-severity vulnerability in Oracle WebLogic Server that is currently being targeted by active exploitation campaigns.

articles.title: Microsoft reaches for olive branch after public dustup with 0-day researcher
articles.summary: Microsoft is de-escalating tensions with security researchers by clarifying that they are not targeting vulnerability hunters with legal action following public backlash. This shift aims to restore industry relations after a dispute over the handling of a zero-day vulnerability.

articles.title: New WordPress Malware Uses Steam Profile Comments to Hide C2 Instructions
articles.summary: Researchers discovered a new WordPress malware strain that uses Steam Community profile comments to store and retrieve encoded command-and-control instructions. The campaign has successfully compromised approximately 1,980 websites.

articles.title: Codex knowledge work expands into research, reports, and spreadsheets
articles.summary: The Codex platform is expanding its capabilities to better support knowledge workers by integrating tools for research, reports, and spreadsheets to reduce time spent on administrative tasks. The update aims to address inefficiencies in information management and document retrieval within enterprise environments.

articles.title: Google fixes actively exploited Android vulnerability (CVE-2025-48595)
articles.summary: Google has released security updates for Android addressing CVE-2025-48595, a high-severity integer overflow vulnerability in the Android Framework that is currently being exploited in targeted attacks to escalate privileges.

articles.title: Halo Security Honored with 2026 MSP Today Product of the Year Award
articles.summary: Halo Security has been recognized with the 2026 MSP Today Product of the Year Award for its contributions to the managed service provider sector. This honor highlights the company's innovation and product effectiveness in the cybersecurity market.

articles.title: AI-Driven Exploitation is Destroying Vulnerability Management. Here’s How to Handle It.
articles.summary: The acceleration of AI-driven exploitation is drastically shortening vulnerability remediation timelines, forcing organizations to address risks within hours rather than days. This shift necessitates a fundamental change in how enterprises manage and prioritize security vulnerabilities.

articles.title: Claude celebrates Anthropic's stock market float with blockbuster ... outage
articles.summary: Anthropic's AI chatbot, Claude, experienced a significant service outage coincidentally coinciding with the company's financial announcement. The technical failure temporarily disrupted user access during a critical moment for the organization.

articles.title: Diligent automates cyber risk assessments and reporting
articles.summary: Diligent has introduced an agentic cyber risk management platform designed to accelerate risk assessments and align security posture with strategic business objectives. The tool aims to streamline reporting and investment prioritization for security teams by consolidating complex risk data.

articles.title: Google fixes one actively exploited Android zero-day, 124 flaws
articles.summary: Google has released the June 2026 Android security update to patch 124 vulnerabilities, including one zero-day flaw that is already being exploited in targeted attacks.

articles.title: Northern Ireland cops issue PSA after official phone number spoofed by scammers
articles.summary: Police in Northern Ireland have issued a public warning after scammers spoofed an official department phone number to solicit fraudulent gift card payments from citizens.

articles.title: How Leading Organizations Are Turning EDR Into Operational Resilience
articles.summary: Organizations are moving beyond basic endpoint protection toward EDR to gain continuous visibility and improve operational resilience against sophisticated, fast-moving threats. This shift emphasizes that traditional prevention is no longer sufficient in the modern threat landscape.
